description: This file defines the EventProvider class, which manages the state and data fetching logic for event data in a Flutter application. It interacts with an EventService to load and search events, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: EventProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages event data and loading state, providing methods to load initial events and perform search filtering.

methods.name: loadInitial
methods.description: Loads the initial list of events asynchronously from the EventService, updating the internal state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for events based on optional query and location filters, updating the state and notifying listeners.
